They reproduce only as 715.7/70,085.9 = 1.0212 % and 588.7/70,085.9 = 0.8399 %, that is, threshold grams divided by the owner's UNADJUSTED total. With the other grams held fixed and the payload renormalised, the thresholds are 1.0219 % and 0.8420 % (0.841 % of a nominal 70,000 g). The flip conditions are really ratio conditions (p_P/p_Li < s_P/s_Li; p_P/p_N < s_P/s_N). An absolute mass-% threshold holds only under the unnamed hypothesis that every other element's grams stay fixed. The carried ICRP 110 conclusion is unaffected, since P 0.813 % is below both thresholds.

ATTRIBUTION STATED BUT NOT READ. 'The 7 mg is Emsley's figure carried under an ICRP label' (hypothesis_drift) and 'The 7 mg is Emsley's' (grade_evidence (3)) are asserted while Emsley p.83 is NAMED-NOT-READ. The attribution rests on a tertiary restatement from the first audit. ICRP 23's Table 108 closing section (elements known in under 20 % of the body, p.286) and Chapter 3 are unreadable or unread, so an ICRP 23 Li value elsewhere is not excluded; the report's own (a) concedes this. Also, the owner's label is 'ICRP 23 / Emsley' (stockgate.py:288-289, :345), so 'under an ICRP label' overstates.

LOGICAL OVERREACH ON THE CAPTION. 'Under its caption's rule, ICRP did not know Li's concentration over half the body.' The caption ('includes only those elements for which the concentration was known in at least 50 %') gives a NECESSARY condition for inclusion. Absence from Table 110 does not entail that condition failed. Li could be absent from Table 108 altogether, or excluded by the p.286 rule that no total-body value is given when the skeleton concentration is unknown. What is shown is only that Li is not in Table 110.

GRADE REASON IMPRECISE. The report says 'the photosphere binder moves with Li'. Computed: no Li value in hand moves the binder. Li 2.17 mg (tertiary) gives P binding with K runner-up at 2.932x; Li 7 mg gives P binding with Li runner-up at 1.0898. The datum that moves the binder is P (ICRP 110 bulk, carried, not re-read here), or a hypothetical Li above 7.6288 mg. What moves with the contested Li datum is the runner-up identity and the near-miss margin the owner states. DATA-DEPENDENT survives on that narrower basis.

MINOR OCR-ALIGNMENT CLAIM. 'Be: no per-cent entry printed' is an inference. P.328 has 18 per-cent cells for 20 rows, and U (0.00009 g, 1.3e-7 %) and Be (0.000036 g, 5.1e-8 %) both round to the printed '0.0000001'. The alignments 'Be and Ra lack an entry' and 'U and Ra lack an entry' each fit all 18 cells. Immaterial: the gram column is unambiguous and neither element binds.

SCRIPT DESIGN (not an error). Table 110 is hand-typed in the script, not parsed from the source text. I verified it cell by cell against an independent positional parse: it matches. Check 6 asserts the thresholds against the prior re-audit's figures, which makes it a regression check, not an independent one; my closed-form recomputation confirms them (7.62881 mg, 715.71 g, 588.68 g, 2385.0 g).
